articles.title: Watchful Mama Bear Gemini Wins the Helicopter Mom Award
articles.summary: Mama bear Gemini won the 2026 Helicopter Mom Award for keeping a close eye on her cubs around other bears at Anan Creek in Alaska.

articles.title: Valkyries Win WNBA Title in Only Their Second Season
articles.summary: The Golden State Valkyries beat Atlanta 68-63 in Game 7, becoming the first WNBA expansion team to win a championship in just its second season.

articles.title: 5 Seconds of Summer Bring Out The Wiggles in Melbourne
articles.summary: 5 Seconds of Summer surprised their Melbourne crowd by bringing out The Wiggles, Dorothy the Dinosaur and friends, for their closing song.
